title: Chicken Corn Soup

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A fixture of Chinese restaurants in Pakistan and India, where the author remembers family dinners spiking it with green chilies and vinegar; by now he counts it as a subcontinental dish. Easy.

steps.action: Bring to a boil in a large pot on high (cube the chicken meanwhile):
items: 7 cups chicken stock (1.7 L), or 3 bouillon cubes in 7 cups water

steps.action: Add; reduce to medium (5/10), cover, and cook 15 min:
items: 1 lb boneless chicken (450 g), in ⅓ in (1 cm) cubes
6 Tbsp cornstarch mixed into 1 cup warm water (240 ml)

steps.action: Reduce to medium-low (3/10); simmer covered 45 min, stirring every 15 min. Turn off heat.
Pour in slowly, stirring very gently, to form egg threads:
Taste; add salt 1 tsp at a time only if needed (stock is usually salted).
Condiment: mix and add to individual bowls a tsp at a time:
items: 4 green chilies (or 1 large jalapeño), thinly sliced
Bread, as a light meal; or as a first course

edits: Source says cornflour (British usage); in the US this is cornstarch
Source doesn't say whether to drain the corn
